acceptedAnswer.text: In California, the statute of limitations for personal injury claims, including those from Lyft accidents, is generally two years from the date of the injury. This means you typically have two years to file a lawsuit in court. However, there are exceptions that can shorten or lengthen this period. It is always best to consult with an attorney as soon as possible to ensure you meet all critical deadlines and do not lose your right to pursue compensation.
